text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having delivered solid results, Eishin 
Flash sat down for an interview regarding 
her future plans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her goal is naturally the Classic Triple 
Crown races— as she makes her bold 
declaration, the press buzzes in 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter how strong the others in 
her generation are. With the feeling she 
grasped today, she is more than ready for 
the Satsuki Sho.
